title: supportedBodyTypes: seen vs accepted types
description: Raised by mimid-13 2026-10-18. Base L245 defines supportedBodyTypes as types 'accepted in bodyType'; mimi-00 L156 requires advertising application/mimi-fanout; mimi-00 L415 requires rejecting Message/set create with it. Deleting L156 instead breaks base L612 (Message.bodyType 'MUST be in supportedBodyTypes') for server-created fanout Messages. Proposed (pending Mark): L245 = the MIME types a Message bodyType can take on this account; the server MUST accept every listed type in Message/set create except types a companion specification reserves for server-created Messages. L156/L415/L612 unchanged. Rejected: a separate serverBodyTypes field (extra mechanism). Combine with jmap-chat-spec-mmcb's text/plain exemption wording in the same edit; check L1655 and compliance 4.2.
notes: Approved by Mark 2026-10-18. Do in the post-crate-jmap-run spec pass with mmcb (same L245 edit); Mark commits.
